The '''JTR cleaning droid''' was a [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] cleaning droid and was considered as an abysmal failure. In [[45 ABY]], [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Luewet Wuul]] was in possession of one since he did not want to be seen owning an item made by SoroSuub's competitors.<ref name="Crucible" />
